scope: Read-only public primary-document guidance for the bounded StreamForge content-profile exercise.
decision: Use focused free primary-document supplements. No new paid course, cloud service, framework, or optional lecture is assigned.

constraints.claim_limit: Synthetic behavior only; no user-value, causal, production, certification, or exam-readiness claim.

catalogAudit.courseTitle: Ultimate AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate 2026
catalogAudit.finding: The section contains service overview material but no title-specific genre feature/profile or train-only scoring lesson. Metadata does not prove spoken content, ownership, or entitlement.
catalogAudit.accessCaveat: No lecture deep link is invented; catalog URLs do not verify access.

primaryReferences.title: Categorical data: Vocabulary and one-hot encoding
primaryReferences.workedExample: Freeze five genre labels and encode one-hot; category indices are not ordinal scores.
primaryReferences.caution: No hashing, embeddings, holdout vocabulary discovery, or expanded taxonomy.

primaryReferences.title: Content-based filtering
primaryReferences.workedExample: Distinct positive media with counts [2,1,0,0,0] produce exact profile [2/3,1/3,0,0,0]; candidate dot scores are 2/3 and 1/3.
primaryReferences.caution: Distinct-item counting and L1 normalization are local choices; scores are not calibrated preference probabilities.

primaryReferences.title: Candidate generation overview
primaryReferences.workedExample: Explain that for unit one-hot items and a fixed nonzero profile, cosine and dot may preserve within-user order; implementation uses dot only.
primaryReferences.caution: No second scoring model; cosine is undefined for zero profiles.

primaryReferences.title: Common pitfalls and recommended practices
primaryReferences.workedExample: Mutate holdout and verify train/catalog-only state and fixed-viewer predictions do not change; new holdout-only viewers may change query cohort.
primaryReferences.caution: Read conceptually; install no scikit-learn. Reused holdout is not untouched final test.

primaryReferences.title: Datasets: Dividing the original dataset
primaryReferences.workedExample: Freeze one heuristic before comparison and label the reused synthetic holdout honestly.
primaryReferences.caution: No silent resplit or claim of unbiased final generalization.

primaryReferences.title: Content-based filtering advantages & disadvantages
primaryReferences.workedExample: Same-genre titles tie; unseen users have zero profile; state the unchanged popularity fallback explicitly.
primaryReferences.caution: Do not describe a genre-only heuristic as rich personalization.

studyRule: 35 minutes total including reading, worked exercise, and five-minute explain-back. No course purchase, service use, or new lesson assignment.
sourceCaveat: References explain general concepts. The five-coordinate exact-Fraction profile, duplicate policy, tie handling, and fallback are local exercise choices, not source-prescribed semantics.
